pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Rafe, The Noisemaker, Is Less A Roaring Thunder And More A Whimpering Breeze**

Rafe, look at me. LOOK AT ME. You've got Germany, Ecuador, and Mexico on your roster, yet you're scoring like your midweek rec league team ran into peak Brazil. Your draft strategy screams "dartboard in the dark," and it's no wonder you're clinging to last place like a barnacle to a sinking ship with a measly 29 points. Meanwhile, Gunner, or as I like to call him, "Bubba G," leads the pack with a hefty 63 points, riding the coattails of France like he's got a golden ticket to fantasy soccer's promised land. Devin, "Ghost Pepper," is trailing closely, but what do you expect from a guy gutsy enough to saddle up with Bosnia? Today's matchups are still shrouded in mystery, but let me tell you something — I'm betting my grandfather's World Cup memorabilia collection that the real action won't come from "Mustard Boy" Zach, who thought drafting Saudi Arabia was a stroke of genius. In this fantasy pool, only those who channel that 1994 World Cup grit will come out on top, and right now, most of you don't even deserve to shine Alexi Lalas' shinguards.
